questions.stem: A 48-year-old woman undergoes a CT scan of the abdomen for evaluation of chronic right upper quadrant pain. The radiologist notes a distinct anatomical line on the scan, which is important for understanding the liver's segmentation and surgical anatomy. This line is crucial in differentiating certain liver structures in surgical planning. Which of the following structures is separated by the line noted by the radiologist, commonly Ref erred to as the CholecystoCaval line?
